def harness_time(fn, inputs=(), outputs=(), warmup=10, rep=50, tries=3):
    """Median µs of fn(*inputs, *outputs) with the harness's CUPTI methodology (cold L2, shifted pointers)."""
    from sol_execbench.core.bench.timing import time_runnable
    for attempt in range(tries):
        try:
            ms = time_runnable(fn, list(inputs), list(outputs), "cuda:0", warmup=warmup, rep=rep,
                               return_mode="median", methodology="cupti")
            return ms * 1e3
        except ValueError as e:                          # CUPTI occasionally drops an iteration's records here
            if not any(m in str(e) for m in ("activity sequence", "No timing results")) or attempt == tries - 1:
                raise

import subprocess,os,time
os.chdir('/tmp/w')
subprocess.Popen("nohup make -k -j4 > build2.log 2>&1 &",shell=True)
h=open('adamod_gemm.cuh').read().replace("Shape<Int<TM>, Int<TN>, _32>","Shape<Int<TM>, Int<TN>, Int<TK>>").replace("template <int TM, int TN, int Stages>\nstruct Tf32Gemm","template <int TM, int TN, int Stages, int TK = 32>\nstruct Tf32Gemm")
h=h.replace("template <class G>\nint run_gemm","template <class G>\nint run_gemm")
open('k_test.cuh','w').write(h)
procs=[]
for tn in (224,208,240):
  for tk in (16,64):
    f=f'kt_{tn}_{tk}.cu'
    open(f,'w').write(f'#include "k_test.cuh"\nextern "C" int f(const float* e,const float* W,const float* b,float* const* o,int B,int d,int s,cudaStream_t st){{return adamod::run_gemm<adamod::Tf32Gemm<256,{tn},0,{tk}>>(e,W,b,o,B,d,s,st);}}\n')
    procs.append((f,subprocess.Popen(f"nvcc -O1 -std=c++17 -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a -I/usr/local/cutlass/include -I/usr/local/cutlass/tools/util/include -ptx {f} -o {f}.ptx 2>&1 | grep -c 'error'",shell=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)))
for f,p in procs:
    out=p.communicate()[0].strip(); print(f,"errors:",out)
